pending-clause.answer: The screen matched the words 'as literal' (an INSPECT operand role, 'used as literal-3' / 'referenced, as literal-1'), not the AS literal of a constant entry or arithmetic; the rule performs no arithmetic and nothing in 2002 standard arithmetic (§2002:8.8.1.x) bears on it. For the exception part (§2002:14.5.12.x): The rule's dependent behaviour is EC-RANGE-INSPECT-SIZE, fatal in the 2002 table (§2002:14.5.12.1.5 'Size of replace items in INSPECT differs'); 2002 enables checking only by TURN (§2002:14.5.12.1), runs the USE declarative for a fatal condition (§2002:14.5.12.1.2) and RESUME AT NEXT STATEMENT is not normal completion (§2002:14.5.12.1.1) so execution continues (§2002:14.8.31.3 GR2). What 2023 changed (MERGE/SORT, EC-I-O, the PERFORM WHEN phrase, the non-fatal clause regrouped, incompatible data) does not reach INSPECT at 2002. Shown at --std 2002: pb1126_inspect_size_ec run this session, output MATCHes its .out (E1-E3 EC-RANGE-INSPECT-SIZE, E4 X  X).

behaviour-switch.answer: The switch (DialectBehavior.InspectBeforeFromFirstEligiblePosition) decides only where an operand's BEFORE delimiter is looked for when it also has AFTER; at 2002 the BEFORE portion runs from the leftmost position (§2002:14.8.21.3 GR8b) and the operand participates where it meets the AFTER portion (§2002:14.8.21.3 GR8). The size check is independent of the region; pb1126_inspect_size_ec MATCH at 2002 this session.
